title: RBACv2 & SSO audit: visibility hunt, alert recalibration, and remediation playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: After rolling RBACv2 and SSO/SAML changes into staging last month, we detected gaps in audit ingestion and two classes of false-negative alerts for admin-role changes. This ticket defines a visibility-focused hunt, alert recalibration, and short remediation playbook to ensure audit events are complete, SAML assertion errors are surfaced quickly, and admin grants are never missed by monitoring.

Problem statement:
- Audit ingestion latency occasionally spikes (>30s) causing alert dedup lags and missing policy-change events.
- SAML assertion verification errors increased in staging after library bump; on some error paths we fail silently.
- RBACv2 policy delta events (role grants/revokes) are undercounted because of a filtering rule introduced during migration.

Goals for this ticket:
1) Restore full visibility into RBAC policy changes and SSO failures within 24 hours of occurrence.
2) Recalibrate alerts so true positives are actionable and false positives are reduced by >= 50%.
3) Ship short-term mitigations (fallback audit forwarder, temporary alert rule) and a medium-term fix to remove the filter that dropped role-change events.

Scope (what we'll do here):
- Hunt across ingestion pipelines for dropped or delayed audit events (CloudWatch/Datadog traces, Kinesis metrics).
- Add scoped, high-signal alerts for: missing SAML assertions, backlog growth in audit-forwarder, spike in admin-grant events and unusual actor patterns.
- Implement a temporary replication (audit-forwarder -> durable S3 bucket) for forensic recovery.
- Patch RBACv2 policy serializer to stop emitting empty deltas; add unit tests.
- Create a playbook entry for on-call to follow when an SSO/SAML or RBAC alert fires.

Out-of-scope: long-term redesign of audit storage or migrating to a new audit schema; those will be follow-on tickets.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Alert coverage: new alerts deployed to prod (missing-saml-assertions, audit-forwarder-lag, admin-grant-spike) with runbook links.
2) Telemetry: For a 72h window after deployment, 99.9th percentile audit-ingest latency < 10s and backlog size < 500 events.
3) Code: RBACv2 serializer fix merged and deployed to staging with unit tests demonstrating delta emission for role changes.
4) Recovery: Replication to S3 is running and can be used to restore 24h of audit events in < 2 hours.
5) Documentation: Playbook and dashboards linked in ticket and Console update published.
tasks: Run visibility hunt: compare audit counts by entity across source services and central ingestion (Datadog -> Kinesis -> processor) using histogram rollups
Add scoped alert: missing-saml-assertions (threshold: >5 failed assertions in 5m) and link to playbook
Add backlog alert: audit-forwarder-unprocessed > 1000 events for > 5m
Add behavioral alert: admin-grant-spike (>3x baseline in 1h) with anomaly detection flag
Deploy temporary audit replication to S3 for 7-day retention for fast forensic recovery
Patch RBACv2 serializer to include explicit change-event envelope, add unit+integration tests
Instrument SDK error paths: ensure SAML verification errors are logged with assertions id and actor metadata
Create runbook entry in Console/Runbooks for on-call: triage checklist, escalation matrix, sample queries
Post-deploy verification: run end-to-end test that creates role changes and asserts event appears in central timeline within 30s
